name: Ardennes Crossroads
briefing:
Ardennes, December 1944. Fictional starter action: an American infantry detachment approaches a German-held village crossroads from the west. Each side has nine regular infantry platoons in three companies: eight platoons cover the full north-south frontage and one starts behind them as a reserve. Each platoon occupies one hex. The Americans take the first turn.

AMERICANS: seize the primary objective at hex 4,3. GERMANS: hold the crossroads or retake it after a withdrawal. The road is the direct approach; woods and broken ground provide alternate routes.

Play six full rounds (one American turn and one German turn per round), resolving engagements through the existing battle-result and casualty-entry workflow. After round six, a side wins if it has a living unit on hex 4,3 and no living enemy unit in an adjacent hex; otherwise the result is a draw. Assess this training objective manually; the game does not stop or declare a scenario winner automatically.
